items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that etaleness is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6425-6429). The proof displays the equivalence with flat plus G-unramified morphisms, records that both of those properties have already been shown to be fpqc local on the base, and concludes (proof lines 6431-6438). The level is H2: a short card, but the decomposition is written out and both ingredients are matched to their earlier lemmas.
